caption: The drawing features five distinct objects arranged vertically on a plain, light beige background. At the top, there is a thin, disk-shaped object with radial lines on its surface, supported by a central dark stem connected to an oval base colored in a light tan shade. Below, there are two irregular, puzzle piece-like shapes side by side, each with pastel washes of pale blue and pink. Directly underneath these, a single, irregular quadrilateral-like shape appears, filled with similar pale blue and pink tones. At the bottom of the composition, a simple, stylized fish shape with a single eye is rendered, also filled with a subtle gradient of light blue and pink hues. Each object is outlined with thin, precise lines, and the image is signed "M. Fenga" at the lower right corner.
title: Thread Winds
